note: only match at a shell command boundary and after stripping quotes/heredocs: the first version matched anywhere and fired on a shell line that merely contained 'git checkout --' inside a printf payload while testing the hook itself

before: // Only match at a shell command boundary (start, or after ; && || | newline), allowing env-var
// prefixes and wrappers, so a command that merely *mentions* "git checkout --" inside a string
// or a comment does not fire.
after: // Test runners summarise failures with a count or a fixed token. Bare "failed" is avoided: it appears in passing test names.
